app.setup.title_default.why: Plain factual state, no instruction, holds the ContentUnavailableView title register.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged phrasing distinct from the plain off-state title above it.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Une fois un site protégé, il ne peut plus détourner vos appuis.
app.setup.detail_default.back: Once a site is protected, it can no longer hijack your presses.
app.setup.detail_default.why: "Appui" covers tap and click as the vocabulary defines "press".

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Safari n'a pas répondu cette fois. Si vous l'activez, l'app le remarquera seule.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: Safari didn't answer this time. If you enable it, the app will notice on its own.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: No raw error code, reassures no manual refresh is needed.

app.setup.open_button.why: Names the real destination (Extensions pane) and works verbatim on both screens.

app.welcome.heading.why: Warmer register allowed only here; brand name kept untranslated.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Plain noun phrase matching the vocabulary's own term for the trick.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Une couche invisible peut intercepter un appui destiné à autre chose.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: An invisible layer can intercept a press meant for something else.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person would experience, not the mechanism.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Concrete noun phrase, not marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Certains liens changent de destination entre l'appui et le relâchement.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some links change destination between the press and the release.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Names both moments of the gesture plainly.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Concrete term for the trick without marketing gloss.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Un nouvel onglet ne s'ouvre que là où vous avez vraiment appuyé.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: A new tab only opens where you actually pressed.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Phrased as a promise, as the brief asks, rather than a description of the trick.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Chaque destination devient une ligne à autoriser ou bloquer, ici ou partout.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination becomes a row to allow or block, here or everywhere.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Fits both the review action and the here/everywhere scope choice in one sentence.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Le bouton Undirect de Safari active la protection sur le site affiché.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Safari's Undirect button turns on protection for the displayed site.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: Names the exact mechanism, the toolbar button.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Short enough for a narrow sidebar column, works as nav title too.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own French term for this screen on both iOS and macOS.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: One word, reads as the clear opposite of "Par site" beside it.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: A wiring/first-contact state, distinct from a genuinely empty content list.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Ouvrez une page dans Safari : la liste apparaîtra.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open a page in Safari: the list will appear.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: States the simple fix, French spacing before the colon.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Plain content-empty state, contrasts with the wiring state above.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Une règle apparaît après votre premier choix.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: A rule appears after your first choice.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains a rule is created by a decision, not by merely being seen.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Number placed at the end avoids French singular/plural noun agreement issues.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: One word, clear opposite of "Autorisé" in the same list.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Infinitive imperative, Apple's own convention for a menu action.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Fits the tight tooltip budget while naming the control's action.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the explicit rule, not setting a new verdict.

app.watched.empty.title.why: Plain statement, no site has been switched on yet.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Appuyez sur le bouton Undirect dans Safari pour protéger un site.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Tap the Undirect button in Safari to protect a site.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Names the exact toolbar mechanism to get the first entry.

app.watched.footer.s: Cette liste s'allonge depuis le bouton Undirect de Safari.
app.watched.footer.back: This list grows from Safari's Undirect button.
app.watched.footer.why: Reminds where new entries come from, this screen cannot add one.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Plain read-only status word, no button implied.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb for a small trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.s: Désactive la protection pour ce site.
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.back: Turns off protection for this site.
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Fits the tooltip budget while describing the button's effect.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: The master switch's noun label; feminine, kept consistent with the popup's own Protection toggle.

app.settings.state_on.why: Feminine agreement, reused generically for Protection and the page-note toggle.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Names the choice of which sites the guard runs on.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Keeps the person's point of view the brief asks for, over the default mode.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Names the automatic, always-on mode plainly.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Matches the vocabulary's "note in the page" concept, feminine for state agreement.

app.settings.policy_heading.why: The vocabulary's own term for this concept, concise.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short imperative phrase, parallel to "Autoriser par défaut".

ext.meta.name.why: Proper noun, kept untranslated in Safari's Extensions list.

ext.meta.description.s: Empêche les pages de détourner vos clics vers un lien ou un site indésirable.
ext.meta.description.back: Stops pages from hijacking your clicks toward an unwanted link or site.
ext.meta.description.why: Explanatory register for a reader who has never used the extension.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name for the product itself, brand kept.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.back: Protection turned on for this site
ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States the active state for the tab's site, within the tooltip word budget.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.back: Protection off: tap to turn it on
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as the call to action, French spacing before the colon.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Brief explanation that no website is open on this tab.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Concise headline for the empty-tab state, sits beside a small icon.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: Ouvrez un site, puis appuyez ici.
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Open a site, then tap here.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: "Ici" keeps the self-reference to the toolbar button the popup hangs off of.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: Activer la protection sur ce site
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: Turn on protection for this site
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Sr-only label naming what the switch controls, since the row already shows the site name.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Brief reason the per-site switch is disabled, fits the tight subtitle budget.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.s: Déjà actif partout, via les réglages.
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Points to the everywhere mode elsewhere in Settings that makes this switch redundant.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Names the global master switch as the reason, distinct from the two other disabled reasons.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: Activée : la désactiver recharge la page.
ext.popup.watch_on.back: On: turning it off reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms state and warns of the reload, French spacing before the colon.

ext.popup.watch_off.back: Off: turning it on reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Mirrors "watch_on" as a clear before/after pair sharing the same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Matches the vocabulary's "page" concept, distinct from the site-wide rule lists.

ext.popup.page_off.s: Rien n'est suivi : la protection est désactivée ici.
ext.popup.page_off.back: Nothing is tracked: protection is off here.
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22; translated speculatively to match its sibling states' voice.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Rien n'a tenté de sortir de cette page.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: Nothing has tried to leave this page.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: Plain statement that the page has been quiet so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key, kept as a near-synonym of "page_quiet" per its own notes.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Elliptical feminine form ("tentative" implied) for the singular badge.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Plural pair to "stopped_one", feminine plural agreement.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: "Repérée" covers both blocked and allowed, broader than "bloquée".

ext.popup.tries_one.why: "Fois" is invariant in French between singular and plural.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Same invariant word as "tries_one", per French grammar.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Short prefix that reads naturally before the colon-joined fix name.

ext.state.blocked.why: Short form combining with a following scope word, e.g. "Bloqué partout".

ext.state.removed.why: Distinct from allow/block since a local trap has no destination to rule on.

ext.scope.here.why: Composes after a verdict word as "Bloqué sur ce site".

ext.action.allow_here.why: Unambiguous, distinct from the everywhere variant.

ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Consistent with the container app's equivalent heading.

ext.policy.block.why: Matches the app-side phrasing for the same choice.

ext.policy.allow.why: Matches the app-side phrasing for the same choice.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Les réglages de sécurité de cette page bloquent une partie de la protection.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's own security settings block part of the protection.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Names it as a limitation of this one page, not a bug.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Short tag for the comma-joined list, names a clickable invisible element.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than the click-catcher tag, any see-through element.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a script-dispatched click, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: "Pop-up" is standard French tech vocabulary, kept short.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Names the mid-press swap within the tag's word budget.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Short tag naming the trick, ties to the product's own "détourner" vocabulary.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab redirect trick concretely.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Names the tab-under trick concretely within budget.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the earliest, strongest kind of block concisely.

ext.reason.way_back.back: Its address planned for a return.
ext.reason.way_back.why: Brief reason fitting the tight footnote budget.

ext.reason.sized.why: Names the deliberate window size as the reason it was allowed.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Extremely terse per the very tight budget, matches the core hijack framing.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Terse, plain reason within the tight budget.

ext.reason.own_code.why: Names the site's own code as vouching for the window.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: One word, matches the vocabulary's "rule" concept, reused as nav row and header title.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Apple's own accessibility-label convention for a chevron-only back button.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Consistent with the app-side "Everywhere" grouping term.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Clear counterpart to "Partout", consistent with the app side.

ext.rules.empty.why: Terse placeholder, consistent with the app-side empty-rules wording.

ext.action.allow.why: Single infinitive, scope already fixed by the section the row sits in.

ext.action.clear.why: Names removing the explicit rule so the default policy applies, same action as the app-side "Revenir au défaut".

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Consistent with the app-side Settings term.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Consistent with the app-side master switch label, used both visibly and as the sr-only label.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: Feminine agreement with "Protection", consistent state word.

ext.settings.mode_heading.why: Consistent with the app-side mode heading.

ext.settings.mode_watched.why: Consistent phrasing with the app-side mode option.

ext.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Consistent with the app-side everywhere mode.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Tighter two-word budget than the app side, keeps "Note" consistent between the two.

ext.action.report.why: Names the external issue-report action plainly.
